RequestBody.query:
advisorresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations' | where isempty(properties.serviceGroupId) | where properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId =~ '/subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/resourceGroups/CLOUDFITFAKERESOURCEGROUP/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/FakeVM-000' | where properties.category == 'Cost'| extend alternatives = parse_json(properties.extendedProperties.alternatives) | project alternatives
| limit 100
